features.acceptance: 统一模型/版本/命令与历史

m1Acceptance.scope: M1 三种 schema v1 模型、资源与样式、原子命令、增量历史、revision/contentId、保存票据和过期任务保护。

remainingScope: Office-format semantic import/export remains M2–M4.

Office EX draft serialization deliberately rejects documents with resource payload references until assets can be packaged; resource-store ownership/hash contracts are implemented and tested, but asset persistence must not be advertised.
Schema v1 is the only current persisted schema; migration mechanics are tested with synthetic prior-version input, not a released historical format.

features.acceptance: 安全 OPC ZIP/XML 容器

m1Acceptance.scope: M1 有界 ZIP/XML/OPC 读写、类型与关系图、原包和未知部件保留；不含完整 Office 语义映射。

remainingScope: Normative FMT-05 also includes DOCX body/styles/numbering/sections/media mapping, XLSX workbook/cells/styles/formulas/dates/merges mapping and PPTX scene/layout/master/theme mapping; these remain M2–M4.

Semantic editing that preserves unknown nodes and dependencies within changed parts requires the future domain adapter. M1 accepts explicit whole-part replacements while blocking source-object mutation and signed/macro package edits; it does not claim unknown-node-safe semantic editing.

m1Acceptance.scope: M1 MS-CFB v3/v4 容器、FAT/DIFAT/MiniFAT、目录/storage/stream、元数据、有界校验与独立互读。

remainingScope: MS-DOC, BIFF8 MS-XLS and MS-PPT semantic record mapping/writing and actual historical Office application tests remain LEG-02/03/04/06. CFB correctness is not evidence of DOC/XLS/PPT editor support.

m1Acceptance.scope: M1 受测本地文件提交、授权、冲突、临时文件、重读/同步、原子提交、覆盖前备份和失败保原件。

remainingScope: Document the portable Node final identity-check/rename gap: no OS-level rename-if-inode-unchanged guarantee is claimed; retain the mandatory backup and conflict checks.
Known remote filesystem types and UNC paths are rejected, but mapped or unusual filesystems are not comprehensively certified. Directory sync availability is reported to the UI.
Physical power-loss/storage-controller fault behavior is not established by injected IO tests; platform/installer/release validation remains QA-06.

m1Acceptance.scope: M1 真实 30 秒恢复、校验包络、3 份/256MiB 保留、版本水位、进程退出恢复为未保存副本。

remainingScope: Injected ENOSPC-style failures and process-exit recovery do not establish literal machine power-cut behavior or every real filesystem permission/disk-full failure mode.
Recovery schema/hash validation is separate from Office semantic compatibility; unsupported future schemas remain rejected and preserved.
UI recovery currently concerns internal drafts. Full imported Office editing/recovery follows the semantic adapter milestones.

features.acceptance: 隔离 IPC 与零网络

m1Acceptance.scope: M1 实际 Electron sandbox/context isolation、禁 Node、受限 IPC、固定本地资源、拒绝外部连接和文档 worker。

remainingScope: Do not describe a negative fetch test as a complete operating-system packet capture or proof that every Chromium/OS background service emits zero traffic. The application has deny-by-default resource/network policy and no account/telemetry/updater code.
Ongoing exact-version runtime/dependency security review remains required; no exhaustive security audit or formal sandbox certification is claimed.

m1Acceptance.scope: M1 ZIP/XML/CFB 与有限旧格式包封的恶意输入拒绝、有界解析和内容不执行；不含未来语义解析器。

remainingScope: Full DOC/XLS/PPT record-body semantics, nested OfficeArt/slide edit chains, formula AST/evaluation budgets and decoded image/media limits apply when those parsers/decoders are introduced in M2–M4.
M1 does not execute document macros/scripts/OLE/DDE/XLM or decode embedded Office media. Container inspection is not proof that an entire document body is semantically valid.
Retain SEC-02 as implemented with verified M1 subset; do not mark the whole future parsing surface verified.
